entities.name: MurD ligase
observations: Reviewed homologs catalyze addition of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate in peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
The annotated reaction is EC 6.3.2.13 and requires ATP and Mg2+; products are the UDP-MurNAc tripeptide, ADP, and phosphate.
Reviewed homologs are cytoplasmic and associated with peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and regulation of cell shape.

A conserved meso-diaminopimelate recognition motif is annotated near residues 407–410 in homologs; homologs also contain an N6-carboxylysine modified residue in the catalytic region, but positions are not directly mapped experimentally onto the query.
